answer: Proof of Burn serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism, requiring agents to irreversibly destroy native tokens to gain consensus weight. Much like a gale eroding a reef, this capital expenditure renders the creation of multiple identities prohibitively expensive. An attacker attempting to flood the network with sable-colored virtual personas faces a linear cost increase that outweighs any potential gain, ensuring that influence remains tied to verifiable economic sacrifice rather than identity fabrication.
